# aussietvtonight.com

> Australia's fastest, real-time Freeview TV Guide for Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, and Perth. Discover prime time schedules (7:30 PM), what's on TV right now, movies tonight, and live sports across Channel 7, Nine, 10, ABC, and SBS.

## Main Sections

- [Australian TV Guide Tonight (7:30 PM)](https://aussietvtonight.com/): Discover prime time schedules starting at 7:30 PM across all Australian networks.
- [What's on TV Right Now (Live TV)](https://aussietvtonight.com/on-now/): Real-time broadcast progress bars and live Australian television guide.
- [Movies on TV Tonight](https://aussietvtonight.com/movies-tonight/): Complete guide to feature films and cinema broadcast on Australian free-to-air TV tonight.
- [Live Sport on TV Tonight](https://aussietvtonight.com/sport-tonight/): AFL, NRL, Cricket, and live sports broadcasts on TV tonight in Australia.
- [TV Shows & Series Tonight](https://aussietvtonight.com/shows-tonight/): Australian drama, reality TV, and entertainment series airing tonight.
- [Tomorrow's TV Guide Australia](https://aussietvtonight.com/tomorrow/): Upcoming Australian TV schedule and prime time preview for tomorrow.
